messages:
alyssa (engsec): Quick sync — I posted a draft playbook for audit event names + schema for cross-team review: https://go/internal/audit-playbook-draft. Can folks skim? Primarily looking for naming collisions and any customer-facing validation concerns.

jess (eng-platform): skimmed. high level looks good. main ask: normalize the root namespace so it's easy to filter in logs (e.g., 'audit.' prefix). Also +1 on explicit event_version field.

mike (infra): agree on prefix. also we should avoid coupling the event name to internal service names — use logical resource types. e.g. `audit.resource.user.login.succeeded` instead of `audit.authsvc.login_ok`.

olivia (compliance): from a compliance point, we need these invariants for customer-facing audit exports: 
- no raw KMS key material or full key ARN in events (mask last 4 chars)
- PII must be redacted unless the customer has opted in for full exports (opt-in must be explicit)
- include schema_version and event_version so we can opt customers into new fields

sam (prod-eng): +1 on masking. For RBAC changes we should include both before/after snapshot AND a stable change_type enum: `grant`, `revoke`, `modify`. Example payload snippet idea: 
```json
{
  "event_name": "audit.rbac.role.change",
  "event_version": "1.0",
  "timestamp": "2024-06-04T15:14:20Z",
  "actor_id": "user:alice@example.com",
  "resource_type": "role",
  "resource_id": "role:read-only",
  "change_type": "modify",
  "before": {"bindings": [...]},
  "after": {"bindings": [...]},
  "metadata": {"reason": "team request #1234"}
}
```

alyssa (engsec): Good example. Two open questions I want consensus on: 1) event naming pattern — dot-delimited lowecase (`audit.<resource>.<action>.<outcome>`?), 2) how to handle versioning in names vs fields (explicit `event_version` field vs name suffix).

jess (eng-platform): prefer field-only versioning (keep names stable). We use name suffixing for major protocol bumps only. Names should be stable so alerts/dashboards don't break.

mike (infra): +1 to field. Also suggest adding `outcome` as canonical string: `succeeded|failed|partial`. That lets downstream filters be simple.

olivia (compliance): for customer-facing validation, add these checks to the exporter: 
- schema_version present and supported
- no sensitive fields: `raw_key_material`, `secret_value`, `ssn`
- `actor_id` should be hashed if it's a CI token or service principal (unless customer allows full IDs)

spec-bot: Created PR #432 with playbook edits and added JSON Schema validators.

sam (prod-eng): Quick nit — include `resource_namespace` or `tenant_id` for multi-tenant signals. Otherwise cross-tenant dashboards will be noisy.

alyssa (engsec): Good call. Add `tenant_id` to required fields for exported events. Also we should standardize allowed metadata keys so customers don't get unexpected nested blobs. Minimal fields: `event_name, event_version, schema_version, timestamp, tenant_id, actor_id, actor_role, resource_type, resource_id, action, outcome, change_set?, metadata` (metadata must be flat k/v).

jess (eng-platform): We'll add a JSON Schema rule: `additionalProperties: false` at the top-level of `metadata` to enforce flat map. Also set `maxDepth` for metadata values to prevent nesting.

mike (infra): Implementation detail for KMS: when we log key usage events, log `kms_key_id` as `arn:masked:...:****1234` and include `kms_key_alias` if available. Do NOT log `plaintext_key_material`.

olivia (compliance): Also ensure we have retention policy field for exported audits: `retention_days` and a contract with customer before exports start.

alyssa (engsec): Action items: 
- jess: update playbook with canonical naming: `audit.<resource>.<action>.<outcome>` and add JSON Schema (owner: jess, due EOD Thu)
- mike: add masking helper + infra logs sanitizer (owner: mike, due next Wed)
- olivia: write compliance checklist for export opt-in (owner: olivia, due next Tue)
- sam: add tenant_id to event contract and update downstream dashboards (owner: sam, due next Fri)

spec-bot: PR #432 now references tasks: jess -> #440, mike -> #441.

jess (eng-platform): I'll also propose a `validation_level` header for exported streams: `strict|compat|legacy` so customers can opt into strict schema validation before we migrate fields.

alyssa (engsec): Love that. Last point: vuln triage / incident response — we should ensure incidents reference audit event ids to speed forensics. Add `audit_trace_id` (UUID) to every event. That way incident runbooks can pull full chains.

mike (infra): add to schema. Also we can auto-inject `trace_id` at the proxy layer so it's consistent.

olivia (compliance): documented consensus is good. Once jess opens the updated playbook PR, I'll review for export language and legal redaction rules.

alyssa (engsec): thanks all. If no objections I'll merge the playbook PR after jess's update and kick off infra sanitizer work. :thumbsup:

spec-bot: PR #432 merged by jess (eng-platform).
